assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and lightheadedness that have persisted despite initial management for known sick sinus syndrome
To further evaluate the correlation between these symptomatic events and potential arrhythmic activity, a 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is indicated
The service is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The denial is based on Reason Code PR-204
The service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
No payment will be issued for this specific procedure
The patient has a known sick sinus syndrome diagnosis
